items.title: Tiered plans
items.description: Pick the tier that matches your budget and requirements — and move between them without migrating anything.

items.title: Transparent pricing
items.description: The price you see is the price you pay. No hidden costs, no surprise charges at renewal.

items.title: No lock-in
items.description: Your content is plain files in your repository. Leaving is a git clone away.

items.title: Volume discounts
items.description: Annual billing and non-profit or student status both reduce the price.

props.title: From choosing a plan to a live site

items.title: Pick a plan
items.description: Start on Basic if you are unsure. Upgrading later keeps everything you have already built.

items.title: Set up your site
items.description: Clone the template, change the tokens to your brand and write your content as data.

items.title: Publish
items.description: Build once and deploy the static output anywhere, or run it as a server when you need per-request rendering.

items.title: Can I try it before paying?
items.description: Yes. Every plan includes a fourteen-day trial and no card is required to start.

items.title: What happens if I outgrow my plan?
items.description: Move to the next tier at any time. Everything you have built carries over untouched.

items.title: Do you offer refunds?
items.description: If the first month does not work out, write to us and we refund it in full.

items.title: Can I pay annually?
items.description: Yes, and annual billing is cheaper than paying month to month.

props.subtitle: Start on the free trial and see how far you get in an afternoon.
